title: Taylor Townsend Completes Career Grand Slam by Winning US Open with Kateřina Siniaková
seoTitle: Townsend & Siniaková Win US Open, Complete Career Grand.
subtitle: The American tennis player completes her career Grand Slam in doubles alongside Czech Siniaková
excerpt: In Sep 2026, Taylor Townsend & Kateřina Siniaková won the US Open, completing their career Grand Slam in doubles after Wimbledon, Australian Open, & Roland Garros wins.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
In September 2026, Taylor Townsend and Kateřina Siniaková clinched the US Open, completing their career Grand Slam in doubles by winning the tournament that rounds out the four majors. This title follows their victories at Wimbledon (2024), the Australian Open (2025), and Roland Garros (2026).

The Road to the 2026 US Open

After their first Grand Slam doubles title at Wimbledon, Townsend maintained her partnership with Siniaková, which led to consecutive victories in the subsequent majors. Each win bolstered the duo's confidence and solidified their status as one of the most successful pairs in recent history.

Impact of the Victory on Townsend's Career

The US Open victory represents the culmination of a journey that began in 2012, when Townsend was the junior world No. 1 and faced criticism from the USTA regarding her physical condition. Despite the difficulties, she paid her own way to the junior US Open and won the doubles title.

Kateřina Siniaková's Role in the Partnership

Siniaková, the Czech star, joined Townsend in 2024, and together they overcame high-level opponents, such as Gabriela Dabrowski and Erin Routliffe in the Wimbledon final. The synergy between the players was crucial to achieving the Grand Slam.

Significance of Completing the Grand Slam

Completing the Grand Slam places Townsend among the few female tennis players to win all majors in doubles, reinforcing the narrative of overcoming adversity that began when she was deemed “unfit” by the American federation. The victory also highlights the importance of her partnership with Siniaková, which allowed both to make history.

What the Achievement Means for the Future

With the Grand Slam completed, Townsend and Siniaková demonstrate that perseverance and mutual trust can transform challenges into titles. The duo remains active on the circuit, maintaining expectations for new victories in upcoming tournaments.
